best_match.fbbt_definition: Muscle cell of a muscle that is part of the adult ovarian sheath. This is found in the median layer of the sheath, with discontinuous circular muscle found closest to the ovariole and occasional longitudinal fibers in the outer part of the median layer of the sheath (Cummings, 1973).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00003557 'ovarian sheath muscle cell', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
recommendation: Map to the authors' term FBbt:00003557 'ovarian sheath muscle cell', exact match.
